name: Create email template
description: Call this when the user wants a new reusable email template saved in the template library — typically to create an empty or lightly pre-filled draft that is then edited in the template designer. The created template starts inactive, so follow it with the template update/activate action before it can be used by campaigns or transactional sends. Use the regular email campaign creation action instead when the goal is a one-off campaign to send to lists rather than a reusable template, and use the template update action instead when a template with this name/id already exists and only its content or settings need changing.
preconditions: The user must be authenticated in the Brevo web app with access to the email templates area.
The sender referenced by sender_id (and its from_email/from_name pair) must already exist and be configured on the account.

id.description: Template identifier. Observed as null when creating a new template; the server assigns the id.

type.description: Record type being created. Observed value is "template".

name.description: Internal name of the template, shown in the template list (e.g. "New template").

subject.description: Subject line of the email produced by this template.

preview.description: Preview/preheader text shown after the subject in the inbox.

content.description: HTML body of the template. Observed empty on creation, with the body added later in the editor.

sender_id.description: Identifier of the registered sender used as the From address for this template.

from_email.description: From email address matching the chosen sender.

from_name.description: From display name matching the chosen sender.

reply_to.description: Reply-To address. Observed empty, meaning the sender address is used.

to_field.description: Personalised To field expression (e.g. contact attribute placeholders). Observed empty.

tag.description: Free-text tag attached to the template for reporting/filtering. Observed empty.

attachment_url.description: URL of a file to attach to emails built from this template. Observed empty.

profile_update_form.description: Reference to a profile update form linked to this template. Observed empty.

is_active.description: Whether the template is active and usable for sending. Observed false on creation.

tracking.description: Link-tracking and UTM configuration for the template.

google_analytics_active.description: Whether Google Analytics tracking is enabled for links in this template.

utm_campaign.description: UTM campaign value used when UTM tagging is enabled.

utm_id_active.description: Whether a UTM id parameter is appended to tracked links.

value.description: Value for the parameter; may contain placeholders such as [TEMPLATE_NAME].

enabled.description: Whether this UTM parameter is appended to tracked links.

outputs.description: Created template record returned with HTTP 201. The exact response shape was not captured; expect the saved template including its server-assigned identifier.

id.description: Server-assigned identifier of the new template, used by subsequent update, preview, and send actions.

side_effects: A new email template record is created in the account's template library and appears in the templates list.
The template is stored inactive (is_active false), so it is not yet available for sending until activated.
No email is sent by this call.
